statement_summary: One group program aligned to CSF 2.0 with SP 800-82 Rev. 3 for OT
Group CISO accountable; TSA Security and Cybersecurity Coordinators designated and reported
Annual SP 800-30 risk analysis per division with roll-up to group
Risk acceptance authority by level; safety risks rated High must be treated
Division supplements may not weaken group policy; required for every division with OT; annual attestation
Common control catalog; divisions document inheritance each year
Sanctions for policy violations
Third parties under contract with security terms; OT vendor patch timelines; MSSP does not shift responsibility
Changes touching Critical Cyber Systems go to the rail change board for a CIP amendment decision
Acquisition security gate; TSA applicability 90 days before new or modified rail operations
Annual assessment of common controls and division samples; one-third of CIP measures each year
Written, risk-rated, time-limited exceptions; no CIP change without amendment
AI systems registered and approved before deployment
Unique accounts; shared accounts only where critical and vaulted in PAM
Least privilege and separation of duties, with documented compensating controls
MFA for remote, privileged, email, cloud, FCI, and personal information systems; OT compensating controls in the CIP
Memorized secrets per SP 800-63; reset when a shared-secret holder leaves
Disable within 4 hours of termination; quarterly certification of privileged and OT access
Directory trusts documented and reviewed annually
Vendor access to OT only through PAM; no always-on access or vendor modems
Privileged administration through PAM with separate accounts
Physical access to NOCs, data centers, and OT rooms; locked, sealed PTC housings
Report suspected incidents to the SOC within 1 hour
One group severity scale and playbooks
NOC may order manual dispatch and IT/OT isolation at once
CISA report within 24 hours (72-hour outer limit); TSOC within 24 hours for any railroad
Group notification matrix maintained quarterly; counsel approves notices
Severity 1 to the disclosure committee within 24 hours; Form 8-K within 4 business days of materiality
Ransom payments need board committee approval and an OFAC check
Annual cross-division exercise; each Covered Railroad plan exercised annually on two objectives
Lessons learned within 30 days; CIP amendment if needed
Report unauthorized SSI release to TSA
SSI only to covered persons with need to know, in the restricted library
Screen documents for SSI before sharing outside the group
Restricted information encrypted and accessed by named roles
FCI in the workspace and ERP; media sanitized with a record
Transfer platforms delete personal information within 7 days of delivery
Operations devices for operational use only; no email, browsing, or removable media
Report phishing; never approve unexpected MFA prompts
Call-back verification for any payment instruction change
Only approved generative AI tools; no SSI, FCI, or Restricted data in unapproved tools
Report suspicious items, devices, or sessions at once
